استحيا (form X)
# اِسْتَحَيَا (istaḥayā) /is.ta.ħa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحَى (istaḥā)
# اُسْتُحِيَا (ustuḥiyā) /us.tu.ħi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحَى (istaḥā)
# اِسْتَحِيَا (istaḥiyā) /is.ta.ħi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحَى (istaḥā)
